title: 第140章 羽黛其人第139章 观察得很好下次不要观察了
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
殿内短暂沉默，羽黛又喝了一口茶。
再开口，她却并不再提及此事。
“今日前来，是有一事要跟我这侄儿谈谈。”
“先前我多次想单独见面，但他都对我避之不及。”
“想着他比较听云宗主的话，今日我便亲自上门拜访。”
云洛和凌熠对视一眼，等待对方继续开口。
羽黛起身，手指掐了个诀，下一刻，两盏亮着微弱火光的灯盏出现在二人面前。
“引魂灯？”这造型和大黄的引魂灯不同，但云洛感觉到了熟悉的气息，以及里面千灯草汁液的味道。
“嗯。”羽黛视线落在两簇微弱的火苗上，眼神有些哀伤。
“凌熠，这两盏灯里，分别是你爹娘的魂魄，今后，就交给你来照料了。”
凌熠一下站起身，脚步僵硬走到灯盏面前。
火苗实在太微弱了，他甚至不敢呼吸。
定定看了许久，他眼眶猩红，眼中一滴泪挂在眼眶边缘，将落未落。
“我凭什么信你，我爹娘死在下界，没有完整的一魂或者一魄，根本无法引魂。”
羽黛看着他，像是在回忆什么，碧绿的眼中多了些水光。
“小凤凰，别激动，听听她怎么说。”
云洛拍了拍他肩膀，其实从听说羽黛找过凌熠的事后，她就猜测当年的事另有隐情。
不过凌熠才是那个肩负血海深仇的人，仇恨会蒙蔽双眼。
作为一个旁观者，她不能仅凭猜测给羽黛说好话。
羽黛是个骄傲的人，别过头，不让人看到她的脸，声音又干又紧。

“那是你亲生父母，是不是，你感知一下便是。”
“我与你母亲是惺惺相惜的竞争对手，但更是数千年的好友，比亲生姐妹关系更要亲近，我怎么可能眼睁睁看着她去死。”
“但那时，我没有能力去反抗，只能表面与凌烟反目成仇，这样，我才能取得亲自为火凤族拔去仙骨的任务。”
羽黛说到这，深呼吸了一口。
火凤族的仙骨，是她亲自剔除的，每每想起，都让她颤抖，呼吸困难。
她冷静了许久，才继续道：
“我事先查到，只需一魄，便可靠引魂之术集齐魂魄。所以，在剔除火凤族的仙骨时，我偷偷取出了他们的一魄。并在剔除后，快速将人打入下界。”
这样，在别人看来，就是她迫不及待消灭竞争对手，好坐稳少族长的位置。
上千年，她一直小心翼翼保留着这些魂魄，偷偷搜集可以引魂的法宝。
但她那时她头顶有族长和大祭司压着，根本不敢轻举妄动。
一直到她突破下神，又花了几十年重整凤族内部，她才敢点燃这引魂灯。
从过往回忆中走出，羽黛眨眨眼将泪意逼回，才转过身，手中出现一个冒着寒气的玉盒。
“这里面，是你剩下族人的一魄。这些年，我搜了许多可以引魂的法宝，但千灯草汁液过于稀少，目前也只够你爹娘的。”
“至于其他人的，我也搜集了一些普通一点的法宝，剩下不够的，你也长大了，该你肩负起这份责任。”
凌熠早已恍惚，他从未想过，自己爹娘还有复活的可能。
而做这件事的，居然就是他一直憎恨之人。
他颤抖手接过玉盒，明明只有巴掌大，却仿佛有千斤重。
content_en:
There was a brief silence in the hall, and Yu Dai took another sip of tea.
When she spoke again, she did not mention the matter again.
"I came here today because I have something to talk to my nephew."
"I wanted to meet alone many times before, but he avoided me."
"I think he listens more to Sect Master Yun, so I will pay him a visit in person today."
Yun Luo and Ling Yi looked at each other, waiting for the other to continue speaking.
Yu Dai stood up and made a sign with her fingers. The next moment, two lamps with weak firelight appeared in front of them.
"Soul-inducing lamp?" This shape was different from Dahuang's soul-inducing lamp, but Yunluo felt the familiar atmosphere and the smell of Thousand Light Grass juice inside.
"Yeah." Yu Dai's eyes fell on the two weak clusters of flames, her eyes a little sad.
"Ling Yi, in these two lamps are the souls of your father and mother respectively. From now on, they will be left to you to take care of."
Ling Yi stood up and walked stiffly to the lamp.
The flames were so weak that he didn't even dare to breathe.
After staring for a long time, his eyes were scarlet, and a tear hung on the edge of his eye, almost falling.
"Why should I believe you? My parents died in the lower world. Without a complete soul or soul, there is no way to attract the soul."
Yu Dai looked at him as if she was recalling something, her green eyes filled with water.
"Little Phoenix, don't get excited, listen to what she has to say."
Yun Luo patted him on the shoulder. In fact, ever since she heard that Yu Dai had approached Ling Yi, she had guessed that there was something hidden about what happened back then.
But Ling Yi is the one who bears the blood feud, and hatred can blind his eyes.
As a bystander, she couldn't say good things about Yu Dai based on mere speculation.
Yu Dai is a proud person. She turns her head away so that no one can see her face, and her voice is dry and tight.
"Those are your biological parents, right? Just feel it."
"Your mother and I are rivals who cherish each other, but we have been friends for thousands of years. We are closer than biological sisters. How could I watch her die?"
"But at that time, I didn't have the ability to resist, so I could only superficially turn against Ling Yan. In this way, I could obtain the task of personally removing the immortal bones for the Fire Phoenix Clan."
When Yu Dai said this, she took a deep breath.
She personally removed the immortal bones of the Fire Phoenix Clan. Every time she thought about it, it made her tremble and make her breathing difficult.
She calmed down for a long time before continuing:
"I found out in advance that only one soul is needed to gather all the souls using the soul-inducing technique. Therefore, when I was removing the immortal bones of the Fire Phoenix tribe, I secretly took out one of their souls. After removing them, I quickly drove the person into the lower realm."
In this way, in the eyes of others, she couldn't wait to eliminate her competitors so that she could secure her position as the young patriarch.
For thousands of years, she has been carefully preserving these souls and secretly collecting magic weapons that can attract them.
But at that time, she had the patriarch and the high priest pressing down on her head, so she didn't dare to act rashly.
It wasn't until she achieved a breakthrough and spent decades reorganizing the Phoenix Clan that she dared to light the soul-inducing lamp.
Walking out of the past memories, Yu Dai blinked back the tears, then turned around, and a cold jade box appeared in her hand.
"What's inside is the spirit of the remaining members of your clan. Over the years, I have searched for many magic weapons that can attract souls, but the juice of Thousand Light Grass is too scarce, and it is only enough for your parents at the moment."
"As for other people's, I have also collected some common magic weapons. If there are not enough left, you have grown up and it is your turn to shoulder this responsibility."
Ling Yi had long been in a trance. He had never thought that there was a possibility that his parents would be resurrected.
And the person who did this was actually the person he had always hated.
He took the jade box with trembling hands. It was only as big as a palm, but it seemed to weigh a thousand pounds.
